name: 64724 · Appleton City, MO
findings: ZIP 64724 (Appleton City) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64724 (Appleton City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
